comparison.objective: Dispense coffee using a spring-return shelf and return a filled mug safely to its saucer.
comparison.physical_skill: Handles a mug, operates a coffee mechanism, and avoids hot-stream contact and spills; it does not perform fine hex engagement or adjustment locking.
comparison.success_condition: Retained volume, zero spill, vessel choice, wall/stream safety, and final placement are scored; no repeated carriage-stop performance is required.
comparison.reason: This is safe beverage service with quasi-static liquid behavior, not adjustment and verification of a mechanical damper. Exact shelf-force and placement thresholds are not fully stated, but missing details do not make the objectives plausibly duplicate.
